Garden.io
Choose plants
Your garden, smarter.

Track changes. Ask what they mean. Keep answers with each plant.

Start your garden
Tour a garden journal

Start with one plant today. Add more only when the garden gives you a reason.

APPLE
First bloom

Apr. 12. Compare fruit set and harvest later.

SIMPLE HABIT
A garden notebook that can answer back.

Add what you notice now. Use it when you water, prune, replant, or ask for help.

Remember the details

Bloom dates, pests, weather, and harvests stay with the plant.

Ask with the full story

A note or photo can include the plant, place, season, and past notes.

Keep what helps

Useful answers can become weekly care or stay in the plant journal.

YOUR PLANTS
Each plant keeps its own story.

The image is the cover. The useful part is the growing history you keep with it.

APPLE
Bloom, prune, harvest

Compare this year's bloom and harvest before next year's pruning.

BORAGE
Pollinators and reseeding

Remember where it bloomed, self-seeded, and brought bees.

BOUQUET DILL
Cuttings and seed heads

Know when to sow again, cut stems, and let seed form.
